Bacterial Blight reference shows scattered small angular brown spots with yellow halos. The test image has a more consolidated, larger brown lesion. Some similarity but not a perfect match. Let me check Septoria brown spot.
Septoria brown spot shows yellowed leaf with small scattered brown spots - very different from the test image. Let me check Soybean Vein Necrosis Virus.
SVNV reference shows yellow spots near veins with brown necrotic centers on an otherwise green leaf - quite similar to the test image. Let me check Bacterial Pustule next.
Bacterial Pustule shows many small, discrete raised spots with brown centers - very different pattern from the test image's larger consolidated lesion. Not a match. Let me check Downy mildew.
Downy mildew shows many small scattered yellow spots - not matching. Let me check Phyllosticta leaf spot.
Phyllosticta shows a tan/brown lesion with dark purplish margins at the leaf edge. The test image has yellowish margins rather than purplish. Let me check Frogeye leaf spot.
Frogeye leaf spot shows small circular gray/purple spots - very different. I've viewed 7 classes so far. Let me use my 8th view on Soybean rust to complete the 8-class requirement.

Soybean rust shows many small tan/brown pustule spots densely scattered - not matching the test image at all.

Now let me synthesize my findings across all 8 references:

**Test image features:** A soybean leaf with a large, irregular brown necrotic lesion with yellow/chlorotic margins, on an otherwise green leaf. The lesion appears to be associated with the vein area.

**Comparison summary:**
- **Bacterial_Blight**: Small angular spots with yellow halos that can merge - somewhat similar but test lesion is more consolidated with broader yellow margin
- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Small dark spots on yellowed leaf - no match
- **Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus**: Yellow spots along veins progressing to brown necrotic lesions - **best match**. The SVNV reference showed the same pattern of yellow chlorosis near veins with brown necrotic progression
- **Bacterial_Pustule**: Small raised spots - no match
- **Downy_mildew**: Many small scattered yellow spots - no match
- **Phyllosticta_leaf_spot**: Tan lesions with purplish margins - margins don't match (test has yellow, not purple)
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Small circular gray spots with dark borders - no match
- **Soybean_rust**: Dense small tan pustules - no match

The test image most closely matches Soybean Vein Necrosis Virus: irregular yellow spots along/near veins that progress to red-brown necrotic lesions, with vein-associated pattern on an otherwise green leaf.
